summary: Fixed a quota-keeper bug where overlapping workers erased each other's YouTube API usage, wrote verdicts for three Paisa Panchayat Shorts, and handed three owner notes to the improver.
why: Two overlapping worker saves lost one run's uploads and covers (new test fails 2 of 2 on the old code). Tonight's data audit hadn't run yet (GitHub starts it 3.5-5 h late), so the data check was skipped; last night's audit was clean.

findings.title: Quota usage could go backwards
findings.detail: QuotaKeeper.save() overwrote the whole row with what the run loaded at its start plus its own spending; publish, the data audit, stats-deep and the market scan overlap.

findings.title: Data audit lands after the auditor
findings.detail: Scheduled data-audit runs started at 17:41 UTC (17 Nov) and 17:21 UTC (18 Nov), after this routine. Info notification raised with two fixes.

findings.title: Three 17 Nov Shorts are hits
findings.detail: Disneyland ticket 973 views, Edwin Castro 447 at 48 h (but 8% held after the hook: a 35-point fall on the loop line), gas stations 425; Shorts median 95.

changes.title: Quota keeper adds only its own spending on save
changes.detail: workers/lib/quota.ts mergeUsage + save() re-reads the row; workers/tests/quota.test.ts.
